success.description: # You launch all your heads in an attack at a single target. You hit for normal damage, +1 damage per living head beyond the first.
As above, plus the attack inflicts 1 or more critical wounds on the target. The draw of all critical wound cards drawn equals or exceeds the number of living heads you still possess.

sigmarsComet.description: One of your destroyed heads grows back to life.

conservative.requirements: beyond the first involved in attack. After the attack is resolved, add 1 recharge token to this card for each living head you possess.
